name: Ace of Wands
keywords: the spark of a new start

facts.hand-cloud: A hand coming out of a gray cloud on the right holds a wand straight upright.
facts.hand-glow: Pale rays of light spread around the hand.
facts.sprouting-wand: Green leaves sprout from the tip and the side branches of the wand.
facts.falling-leaves: Eight leaves fall around the wand.
facts.castle-hill: A small castle can be seen on the hill at the left.
facts.river-trees: A river flows below, a few trees stand on the right, and mountains lie far off.

glosses.sprouting-wand: A possibility that has just sprouted and is still growing.
glosses.falling-leaves: Can be read as a sign that the spark has not yet taken hold.
glosses.castle-hill: The goal or result is still far away.
glosses.hand-cloud: An opportunity handed over; whether to take it is up to you.

reversedGloss.blocked: Wanting to start, but the fire does not catch easily.
reversedGloss.excess: Drive runs ahead, and several things are started and scattered.
reversedGloss.internalized: The idea is still growing only inside the mind.

misdescriptions.wrong: A hand comes out of the cloud on the left.
